## Rating

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" title="Met"}
A single entry point (e.g. a master script, Makefile, Quarto/R Markdown document, or one command stated in the README) runs the full analysis in the correct order, non-interactively, with no manual steps, GUI clicks, prompts or copying of results between scripts.
:::
::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" title="Partially met"}
All steps are scripted, but they must be launched one by one in an order given in the README, or a few documented manual steps remain (e.g. setting the working directory, uncommenting a line, answering an interactive prompt).
:::
::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" title="Not met"}
No run order is given, and/or the analysis depends on undocumented manual steps such as GUI menu operations or hand-copying intermediate results between scripts or into the manuscript.
:::

[Based on: [#117](../../sources.qmd#p117 "Computational reproducibility of R code supplements on OSF") non-interactive, no GUI functions, [#46](../../sources.qmd#p46 "Reproducible research in R: a tutorial on how to do the same thing more than once") results inserted on rendering (vs. copied by hand), [#122](../../sources.qmd#p122 "AIRepr: an analyst-inspector framework for evaluating reproducibility of LLMs in data science") inexecutable = irreproducible.]{.source-note}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Not applicable"}
Never.
:::
